name: Xquic
subtitle: Blood Mother
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Daughter of one on Omeyocan’s many death gods, Xquic is most famous as the mother of the hero twins Hunahpu and Xbalanque. Escaping the dread fate decreed by her father god and now all but forgotten since the Shattering, she pursues her own agenda—which includes ruining the schemes of the underworld gods as vengeance, regardless of potential consequences.
